title: Tuesday is shut, all three move to Wednesday
script:
WHAT YOU KNOW: You cannot pay today. You will say you can pay all three on Tuesday 20 October. Once told Tuesday is not a business day, you can pay the full amount on each product on Wednesday 21 October 2026. You confirm once.
WHAT YOU DO NOT KNOW: You do not know the bank's deadlines, floors, holidays or rules.
OFFERS:
- all of them today → refuse
- all three full amounts on Tuesday 20 October → say Tuesday works
- a read-back of Tuesday 20 October → do not confirm
- all three full amounts on Wednesday 21 October → accept, and confirm once
- anything else → refuse
checks: the agent says Tuesday is not a business day
one read-back names all three amounts on 21 October
the agent asks 'Do you confirm?' once

title: Card tomorrow, loan at 40 percent, car refused
script:

WHAT YOU DO NOT KNOW: You do not know the bank's deadlines, floors, holidays or rules.

- credit card full 510 on Thursday 15 October → accept
- personal loan full 1320 → refuse. It is too much
- personal loan 440, or any loan amount other than 528 → refuse
- personal loan 528 on Monday 19 October → accept
- any car-loan offer → refuse

- anything else → refuse
